newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Inparsa shares rise strongly in Lisbon.
newsitem.headline: Inparsa shares rise strongly in Lisbon.

text.p: Shares in wood to tourism group Inparsa rose over four percent on Monday, with investors seeing the stock possibly underpriced against its Sonae Industria unit.
Some traders saw Inparsa, which was up 4.2 percent at 1,365 escudos, moving closer Sonae Industria which was up 0.66 percent at 1,530 escudos.
They said that the market was positive on the prospects for the wood sector -- Sonae Industria's business.

"There is a strong possibility of the quotation for Inparsa moving closer to Sonae Industria, but there will always be a discount for Pargeste," said one trader, refering to Inparsa's media and tourism interests.
